body_html:
CfA's legal basis for collecting and using the personal data described in this policy depends on the personal data we collect and the specific context in which we collect the information:

  • You have given CfA permission to collect your data.
  • Processing your personal data is in CfA's legitimate interests.
  • CfA needs to comply with the relevant laws and legislation.
headline: Legal basis for collecting and processing personal data
